name: Elena Petrova
education: B.S. in Computer Science, University of Washington
summary: Backend engineer turned cloud platform engineer with 5 years of experience writing Go services and managing Kubernetes infrastructure with Terraform on AWS. Strong on deployment, reliability, and observability, but moving back toward service engineering means rebuilding gRPC and system design depth.
strengths: Solid Go development with 5 years of professional usage
Production Kubernetes and Terraform infrastructure expertise
Deep AWS, Docker, and observability experience
Strong on reliability, CI/CD, and platform automation
gaps: No gRPC production experience; services are REST and HTTP based

resumeText: Cloud Platform Engineer at Cobalt Systems, where I write Go tooling and manage Kubernetes clusters with Terraform on AWS. At Atlas Infrastructure I standardized cluster provisioning and observability across ten teams. I am returning to service engineering and want to apply my platform depth to product backends.
